description: Final consolidation: UniProt evidence status for Q8WZY7, full evidence matrix, GO decision table and requirements scorecard
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os, json
os.makedirs("out",exist_ok=True)

# --- last gap check: is APG-6 supported by expression/proteomics evidence? ---
j=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8WZY7.json",timeout=60).json()
print("=== Q8WZY7 evidence status ===")
print("Protein existence:", j.get("proteinExistence"))
print("Entry type:", j.get("entryType"))
dbs=sorted({x["database"] for x in j.get("uniProtKBCrossReferences",[])})
print("Cross-ref databases:", ", ".join(dbs))
prot=[d for d in dbs if d in ("PRIDE","PeptideAtlas","ProteomicsDB","MassIVE","jPOST","PaxDb","EPD")]
print("Proteomics cross-refs present:", prot if prot else "NONE")
print("Note: protein existence level is the strongest single statement UniProt makes about whether the product has been observed.")

# --- consolidated evidence matrix (all 3 iterations) ---
EV=[
("PMID 11038174","direct assay","supports","Atg4 cleaves after Gly116 of Atg8, exposing glycine",
 "Yeast Apg8 C-terminal Arg117 removed by Apg4; Gly116 becomes the C-terminus (Apg8FG)",
 "S. cerevisiae, in vivo + in vitro","high; defines the requirement, reference organism not N. crassa"),
("PMID 11100732","direct assay","supports","The exposed C-terminal Gly is the PE acceptor; Atg7 E1 and Atg3 E2 are required",
 "Amide bond between Atg8 C-terminal Gly and the PE amino group; Atg7 activates, Atg3 transfers",
 "S. cerevisiae, MS + genetics","high; defines the enzyme set that was then checked in N. crassa"),
("PMID 19021777 / PDB 2ZPN","structural","supports","Two hydrophobic pockets of Atg8 capture Trp and Leu of a WxxL AIM",
 "Atg8-Atg19 and LC3-p62 structures; 15 Atg8 residues contact the WEEL peptide, defining HP1 and HP2",
 "S. cerevisiae Atg8 crystal structure + NMR","high; source of the contact set used here"),
("PMID 20818167","direct assay","supports","Atg4B has a defined P4-P1 preference around the scissile Gly",
 "Ac-GTFG-AFC selected as the optimal tetrapeptide; mutating the Gly proximal to the scissile bond abolishes activity",
 "recombinant human autophagin-1/ATG4B","moderate; human enzyme, informs but does not prove fungal cleavage"),
("This work: UniProt Q8WZY7 + Needleman-Wunsch","computational","supports","APG-6 has Gly at the Atg4-exposed position with a cleavable extension",
 "78.6% id to yeast Atg8; Gly116 aligns 1:1 with no offset; 110-SGENTFG-116 identical; propeptide 117-DFETA-121",
 "sequence","high for the residue call; cannot show that cleavage occurs"),
("This work: PDB 2ZPN contact map + alignment","structural/computational","supports","The AIM-docking surface is conserved in APG-6",
 "15/15 AIM contacts identical, 13/13 pocket-lining; 100% vs 78.6% background, binomial p=0.027",
 "structure-guided homology","high conservation; no measured APG-6 interaction"),
("This work: AF-Q8WZY7-F1 v6 + rigid AIM transplant","structural/computational","supports","The pockets are geometrically formed and accept a WxxL peptide",
 "CA RMSD 1.65 A over 111 residues; 41/41 peptide atoms in contact; overlaps only at Arg28/Lys46 rotatable rim side chains (controls 0,1,0)",
 "AlphaFold model + rigid transplant","moderate-high; a model and an unrelaxed peptide, not a measured complex"),
("This work: AF-Q8WZY7-F1 pLDDT + geometry","computational","supports","The cleavage site is accessible rather than packed against the fold",
 "pLDDT 95.8 core vs 37.5 for 117-DFETA-121; CA distance from core centroid rises 12.8 -> 27.7 A across the tail",
 "AlphaFold model","moderate; disorder prediction, consistent with but not proof of Atg4 access"),
("This work: UniProt proteome 367110","computational","supports","N. crassa encodes the enzymes the cycle needs",
 "atg4/cpr-1 NCU02433 (C226/D399/H401), atg7/apg-5 NCU06672 (C550), atg3/apg-3 NCU01955 (C238), atg5 NCU04662, atg12 NCU10049",
 "genome annotation + alignment to yeast active sites","high presence call; no enzyme assay in N. crassa"),
("This work: 43 reviewed fungal ATG8 entries","structural/evolutionary","supports","The 5-residue DFETA propeptide is normal, not degenerate",
 "Cleavage Gly116 in SGENTFG in 36/39 assignable entries; propeptide length ranges 1-9; xFETA is the Sordariomycete signature",
 "Swiss-Prot fungal ATG8 family","high; annotation-derived, Swiss-Prot subset only"),
("PMID 12519185","localization + mutant phenotype","supports","The nearest-architecture ortholog runs the cycle and is functionally required",
 "GFP-IDI7 relocalizes and marks autophagic bodies in vacuoles; idi-7 null blocks female reproductive structures",
 "Podospora anserina (Sordariales), same Gly116/xFETA architecture","high for Podospora; cross-species inference for N. crassa"),
("PMID 15341644","expression","supports","idi-7 is the Podospora ATG8 ortholog and is transcriptionally induced",
 "idi-4 overexpression induces idi-7, 'the orthologue of the yeast ATG8 autophagy gene'",
 "Podospora anserina","moderate; confirms ortholog identity"),
("PMID 36721786","mutant phenotype","supports","ATG8 deletion in a GFETA-architecture Pezizomycotina impairs development",
 "dCsatg8 shows reduced conidiation and defective germination, appressorium formation and virulence",
 "Colletotrichum scovillei","moderate; different genus, supports clade-level function"),
("PMID 23380892","mutant phenotype","supports","The propeptide beyond the cleavage Gly is functionally dispensable",
 "MrATG8 deletion impairs autophagy and conidiation; the C-terminus beyond the cleavage site is dispensable",
 "Metarhizium robertsii","moderate; addresses the longer-extension concern directly"),
("PMID 21965514","mutant phenotype","qualifies","The autophagy pathway is functional in N. crassa",
 "apg-1 (NCU00188) deletion gives the largest phenotype set in the kinase collection",
 "N. crassa","moderate; pathway-level, says nothing about apg-6 specifically"),
("PMID 25333968","mutant phenotype","qualifies","Autophagy genes act in N. crassa female development",
 "Autophagy genes required to mobilise nutrients into developing protoperithecia",
 "N. crassa, screen of 68 genes","moderate; apg-6 not individually named"),
("PMID 37847028","localization/morphology","qualifies","Autophagic structures form in N. crassa",
 "Carbon starvation drives vacuolation filling 70%+ of cytoplasmic volume, plus phagophore-like structures",
 "N. crassa, microscopy","moderate; no molecular marker tying this to APG-6"),
("PMID 38663545","review","qualifies","C-terminal extensions are the norm and require priming",
 "Most ATG8 proteins carry extra residues shielding the Gly; unprimed forms are not detected under physiological conditions",
 "review","orientation only"),
("No paper found","absence of evidence","qualifies","APG-6 processing or lipidation demonstrated in N. crassa",
 "No deletion, GFP-ATG8, PE-conjugation, Atg4-cleavage or localization assay reported for apg-6/NCU01545",
 "PubMed searches, Nov 2026","high that none was found; absence of evidence is not evidence of absence"),
]
ev=pd.DataFrame(EV,columns=["citation","evidence_type","stance","claim_tested","key_finding","context","confidence_limitations"])
ev.to_csv("out/FINAL_evidence_matrix_apg6.csv",index=False)
print(f"\n=== FINAL EVIDENCE MATRIX: {len(ev)} rows ===")
print(ev.stance.value_counts().to_string())
print("refutes rows:", int((ev.stance=='refutes').sum()))
print("rows that are direct N. crassa measurements of APG-6:", 0)

GO=[
("MF","GO:0031386","protein tag","PAINT/IBA + ISS from P38182","RETAIN as ISS/IBA; do not upgrade to EXP",
 "Gly116 at the canonical position plus an intact Atg4/Atg7/Atg3 system make the modifier role predictable, but no N. crassa conjugate has been observed."),
("MF","GO:0019776","Atg8-family ligase activity (as substrate context)","ISS","RETAIN as ISS",
 "APG-6 is the substrate, not the ligase; keep the substrate-side terms and leave ligase terms to NCU06672/NCU01955."),
("BP","GO:0006914 / GO:0000045","autophagy / autophagosome assembly","PAINT/ISS","RETAIN; core function",
 "Autophagy demonstrably operates in N. crassa (PMID 37847028, 21965514, 25333968) and APG-6 is the single ATG8-family protein."),
("BP","GO:0000422","mitophagy","ISS from S. cerevisiae Atg8","NARROW or mark non-core; weakest carry-over",
 "Requires a specific receptor (Atg32 in yeast); no N. crassa receptor or cargo evidence was found. The conserved HP1/HP2 surface makes the capacity plausible, not the cargo."),
("BP","GO:0044804","nucleophagy","ISS from S. cerevisiae Atg8","NARROW or mark non-core; weakest carry-over",
 "Same reasoning as mitophagy; selective-subtype terms are the most transferable-looking and least evidenced."),
("CC","GO:0000421","autophagosome membrane (lipid anchor)","UniProt SubCell ISS","RETAIN as ISS",
 "Follows from predicted lipidation at Gly116; no imaging of APG-6 in N. crassa, though GFP-IDI7 in Podospora is the closest proxy (PMID 12519185)."),
("CC","GO:0005776 / GO:0005773","autophagosome / vacuole","ISS","RETAIN as ISS","Same basis as above."),
("MF","GO:0030674","protein-macromolecule adaptor activity (AIM/LIR docking)","not annotated","LEAD ONLY; do not add without a measured interaction",
 "15/15 AIM-contact residues conserved and the model accepts a WxxL peptide, but no N. crassa receptor binding has been shown. Preferred over 'protein binding' if a receptor is ever identified."),
]
go=pd.DataFrame(GO,columns=["aspect","GO_id","term","current_basis","recommended_action","reason"])
go.to_csv("out/FINAL_go_decision_table_apg6.csv",index=False)
print(f"\n=== FINAL GO DECISION TABLE: {len(go)} rows ===")
print(go[["aspect","GO_id","recommended_action"]].to_string(index=False))

# --- requirements scorecard figure (all values computed in this session) ---
req=[("Gly at the Atg4-exposed position",116,"G116, aligns 1:1 with yeast Gly116",1),
     ("Cleavage context SGENTFG",110,"identical to 36/39 reviewed fungal ATG8s",1),
     ("Cleavable C-terminal extension",117,"117-DFETA-121, 5 aa, Sordariomycete norm",1),
     ("Cleavage site solvent-exposed",116,"pLDDT 37.5 vs 95.8 core; CA 12.8 -> 27.7 A",1),
     ("Atg4 protease encoded",0,"cpr-1 NCU02433, triad C226/D399/H401",1),
     ("Atg7 E1 encoded",0,"apg-5 NCU06672, Cys550",1),
     ("Atg3 E2 encoded",0,"apg-3 NCU01955, Cys238",1),
     ("HP1 (W-site) conserved",0,"8/8 residues identical",1),
     ("HP2 (L-site) conserved",0,"7/7 residues identical",1),
     ("Pockets geometrically formed",0,"AIM accepted, 41/41 atoms, 1.65 A RMSD",1),
     ("Ortholog function demonstrated",0,"Podospora idi-7, PMID 12519185",1),
     ("Demonstrated in N. crassa",0,"no assay of any kind reported",0)]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.4))
labs=[r[0] for r in req]; vals=[r[3] for r in req]; notes=[r[2] for r in req]
cols=["#1f6f4a" if v else "#b03a2e" for v in vals]
y=np.arange(len(req))
ax.barh(y,vals,color=cols,height=.68)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlim(0,1.95); ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["not met / not shown","met"],fontsize=9)
for i,(v,n) in enumerate(zip(vals,notes)):
    ax.text(v+0.04,i,n,va="center",fontsize=8,color="#333")
ax.set_title("APG-6 (Q8WZY7) against every requirement of the ATG8 processing and lipidation cycle\n"
             "11 of 12 met by sequence, structure and genome content; the twelfth is the only one that needs a wet experiment",fontsize=11)
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nArtifacts written: out/FINAL_evidence_matrix_apg6.csv, out/FINAL_go_decision_table_apg6.csv")
